description: Resolving a review thread, or an oracle verdict posting after a failed oracle-review run, starts no GitHub Actions run, so the required oracle-review check stays red until someone runs make oracle-review-recover PR=<n> (which also closes and reopens the PR and clears auto-merge). PRs 3149, 3156, 3158 stayed blocked for hours or more than a day this way. GitHub Actions has no pull_request_review_thread trigger (PR 3193 attempted one; the workflow failed to parse). Work: design the smallest sound mechanism that re-evaluates the check for open PRs whose head has a success verdict, for example a scheduled workflow (cron) that runs the existing recover logic for open soundness PRs, or reacting to an event that does exist (pull_request_review, workflow_run of oracle-verdict, issue_comment); weigh each. Guardrails: no stand-in verdict, no weaker decision logic, no new secrets, and any cron or permission change needs owner approval; the recovery must not clear auto-merge (re-arm it or avoid close/reopen, for example by re-requesting the check run instead).
